flowRoot.flowPara: TIP: Leave the booklet open to this page as you will use these skills frequently!
TIP: This is your Innate skill. That means its always active. In tandem with the Pacts shown below, it's a vital part of the Bloodthane's skill-set.
TIP: This is your Basic skill. It's a lot weaker than most of your other skills, but it never needs to recharge.
When you strike the same foe for the second time in a turn, you may activate a Pact and bind it to that foe. That Pact remains active until you activate a different Pact in this way.
Strike target foe for 4 damage. Once per turn when you end a move action in a square adjacent to a foe, you may play Blade Fury as a free action.
When you activate Savagery Pact, your Pact-bound foe loses 2 health.
Active: Your strikes deal 1 bonus damage.
When you activate Vampiric Pact, you inflict Weaken 1 on your Pact-bound foe.
Active: Whenever you strike a foe, heal yourself for 1 health
When you activate Predation Pact, inflict Cripple 1 on your Pact-bound foe.
Active: Your Speed is increased by 2.
